sponsored.t: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue certain parkland in the borough of Queens
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the city of New York to discontinue certain parkland in the borough of Queens and transfer such parkland to the metropolitan transportation authority.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing certain special accidental death benefits paid to widows and orphaned children of members
sponsored.sum: Increases certain special accidental death benefits paid to a widow or widower or the children of a deceased member of the state and local retirement system.

sponsored.t: Extends the twenty-five year presumptive eligibility period for certain retirement benefits for injuries or illnesses related to World Trade Center rescue, recovery and clean-up operations
sponsored.sum: Extends the presumptive eligibility period, from twenty-five to thirty-five years, for certain retirement benefits for injuries or illnesses related to World Trade Center rescue, recovery and clean-up operations.

sponsored.t: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Provides for compensation and other terms and conditions of employment of certain state officers and employees; authorizes funding of joint labor-management committees; implements agreements between the state and an employee organization; makes an appropriation therefor (Part A); provides for the salaries of certain state officers and employees excluded from collective negotiating units; makes an appropriation therefor (Part B).

sponsored.t: Relates to the determination of salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to the determination of salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund; provides that the salary base for members of the New York city police pension fund whose employment with the police department of the city of New York commenced on or after July 1, 2000 shall be determined in the same manner as members whose employment commenced prior to such date.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retirement of state, county and municipal 911 operators and dispatchers
sponsored.sum: Establishes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain public safety dispatchers, public safety telecommunicators, 911 operators, communications officers, police communication technicians, emergency services operators and emergency services dispatchers employed by the state, or a county or municipal emergency services department.

sponsored.t: Relates to staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people
sponsored.sum: Sets minimum staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people.

sponsored.t: Grants certain county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service beyond twenty-five years
sponsored.sum: Grants Nassau county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service rendered beyond twenty-five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability benefits for certain individuals employed by the Nassau county police department
sponsored.sum: Provides a performance of duty presumption for diseases of the heart for members who serve as an ambulance medical technician, ambulance medical coordinator, ambulance medical technician/supervisor or a member who performs ambulance medical technician related services, or a police medic, police medic coordinator, police medic supervisor, bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, assistant bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, or a member who performs police medic or police emergency ambulance related services and is employed in the Nassau county police department.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of overtime ceiling
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of overtime ceiling for members who first become members of a public retirement system of the state on or after April first, two thousand twelve.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for uniformed correction members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Provides that for New York city uniformed correction revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for uniformed sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Provides that for New York city uniformed sanitation revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Permits New York city correction and sanitation members to borrow from accumulated contributions; repealer
sponsored.sum: Permits New York City correction and sanitation members to borrow from accumulated contributions to their retirement plans.

sponsored.t: Provides for eligibility of certain participants in the New York City employees retirement system to opt into the twenty-five year retirement program for EMT members
sponsored.sum: Provides for eligibility of certain participants in the New York City employees retirement system to opt into the twenty-five year retirement program for EMT members.

sponsored.t: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Provides for a disability retirement for certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Provides for a line of duty disability presumption for any condition of impairment of health caused by diseases of the lung, resulting in total or partial disability or death of certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities.

sponsored.t: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system
sponsored.sum: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system; restores 55/30 for all members; reduces the retirement age from 63 to 62.

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed as probation officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed as a probation officer, supervising probation officer or probation officer trainee of a department of probation in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Provides for the transfer of service credit between certain retirement systems
sponsored.sum: Provides for the transfer of service credit by a member of the New York city police pension fund into the New York city police pension fund.

sponsored.t: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police
sponsored.sum: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police; provides for employer pick-up of certain additional member contributions required to be made by certain participants in the 25-year retirement programs.

sponsored.t: Requires body armor worn by New York city emergency services personnel to be replaced every five years
sponsored.sum: Requires body armor worn by New York city emergency services personnel to be replaced every five years.

sponsored.t: Provides family leave to persons recovering from a pregnancy loss
sponsored.sum: Expands the definition of "family leave" to include persons recovering from a pregnancy loss.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of additional member contributions and basic member contributions for certain retirement system members to allow such contributions to be used as offsets
sponsored.sum: Modifies the definition of additional member contributions and basic member contributions for certain New York city employees' retirement system members who are subject to the twenty-five year retirement program for fire protection inspector members under Article 15 of the retirement and social security law, to allow such additional member contributions to be used to offset a deficit of basic member contributions, or to allow an excess of basic member contributions to offset a deficit of additional member contributions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the submission of requests to the committee on special education for the educational services mandated by an individualized education services program
sponsored.sum: Requires the school district of location shall annually provide written notice to all parents or persons in parental relation to students with disabilities attending nonpublic schools within their district regarding the process for requesting special education services; relates to the denial of services in a city having a population of one million or more for the 2024--2025 school year.

sponsored.t: Relates to obtaining military credit for members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system, the New York city police pension fund, and the New York city fire pension fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to obtaining military credit for members of the New York state and local police and fire retirement system, the New York city police pension fund, and the New York city fire pension fund; provides that the calculation for military credit shall be equal to the product of the number of years of military service being claimed and three percent of such member's compensation earned during the twelve months of credited service.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retirement contributions of career public employees
sponsored.sum: Provides for new retirement contribution rates of certain public employees.

sponsored.t: Provides for retirement credit to fire protection inspector members for a child care leave of absence
sponsored.sum: Provides for retirement credit to fire protection inspector members for a child care leave of absence.

sponsored.t: Provides for retirement credit to emergency medical technicians and advanced emergency medical technicians for a child care leave of absence
sponsored.sum: Provides for retirement credit to emergency medical technicians and advanced emergency medical technicians for a child care leave of absence.

sponsored.t: Relates to calculating certain pensions
sponsored.sum: Relates to calculating certain pensions; increases pension calculation from thirty-five to forty per centum of final average salary.

sponsored.t: Relates to applying cost-of-living adjustments
sponsored.sum: Provides a cost-of-living adjustment for New York public retirement systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement of members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Provides that full escalation date means the first day of the month following the date on which a member completes or would have completed twenty-three years of credited service, with respect to service retirement benefits for uniformed members of the New York city fire department pension fund.

sponsored.t: Provides for a performance and discharge of duty presumption for certain impairments of health of Nassau county fire marshals
sponsored.sum: Provides for a performance and discharge of duty presumption for diseases of the lung of Nassau county fire marshals.

sponsored.t: Provides for presumptions for certain impairments of health
sponsored.sum: Provides for performance of duty presumptions for HIV, tuberculosis and hepatitis for certain Nassau county positions.

sponsored.t: Protects the health insurance benefits of retirees of public employers and contributions of Medicare-eligible retirees of public employers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits public employers from diminishing health insurance benefits provided to Medicare-eligible retirees and their Medicare-eligible dependents or the contributions such employer makes for such health insurance coverage below the level of such benefits or contributions made on behalf of such retirees and dependents by the public employer as of December 31, 2021.

sponsored.t: Affords certain members of the fire department pension fund with new or increased pension benefits for each year of additional service beyond their required minimum service
sponsored.sum: Affords certain members of the fire department pension fund with new or increased pension benefits for each year of additional service beyond their required minimum service.

sponsored.t: Establishes a credit for military spouses and surviving spouses of veterans for competitive examinations
sponsored.sum: Establishes a credit for military spouses and surviving spouses of veterans for competitive examinations whether for original appointment or promotion.

sponsored.t: Relates to the disability retirement for safety and security officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the disability retirement for safety and security officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to retirement eligibility for certain members
sponsored.sum: Provides for retirement without reduction of their retirement benefit upon attainment of at least fifty-five years of age and completion of thirty or more years of service for certain retirement system members.

sponsored.t: Changes the due date by which the New York State teachers' retirement system is required to submit the annual MWBE report
sponsored.sum: Changes the due date by which the New York State teachers' retirement system is required to submit the annual MWBE report to on or before December thirty-first following the end of the teachers' retirement system's fiscal year.

sponsored.t: Provides cost-of-living adjustments for certain public retirees
sponsored.sum: Provides cost-of-living adjustments for certain public retirees, including an adjusted benefit in monthly installments that is equal to the percentage of the change in consumer price index according to the included schedule.

sponsored.t: Relates to the final average salary calculation for Triborough bridge and tunnel members
sponsored.sum: Provides for an alternate final average salary calculation for Triborough bridge and tunnel members where such calculation includes certain dates.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of a twenty-two and one-half year retirement program for emergency medical technicians
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of a twenty-two and one-half year retirement program for members of the New York city employees' retirement system employed as emergency medical technicians and advanced emergency medical technicians and to the establishment of such program for such members who are subject to articles 11 and 15 of the retirement and social security law.

sponsored.t: Provides for a heart disease presumption for certain New York police department traffic enforcement agents
sponsored.sum: Provides for a heart disease presumption for certain New York police department traffic enforcement agents.

sponsored.t: Relates to service rendered by police officers in the agency police services unit
sponsored.sum: Relates to service rendered by police officers in the agency police services unit.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of past service credit for certain deputy sheriffs transferring between the state and local employees' retirement system to the state and local police and fire retirement system
sponsored.sum: Relates to the calculation of past service credit for members in the title of deputy sheriff who provided police protection or correction officer service transferring between the New York state and local employees' retirement system to the New York state and local police and fire retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for ordinary disability benefits and re-employment of disability retirees of the New York city police pension fund Tier III plans
sponsored.sum: Modifies eligibility for ordinary disability benefits and re-employment of disability retirees of the New York city police pension fund Tier III plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability retirement benefits for the presumption of amyotrophic lateral sclerosis for paid members of a fire department in N.Y. City
sponsored.sum: Provides a performance of duty presumption for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis for paid members of a fire department in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to the additional member contributions required of certain EMTs in the twenty-five year retirement program
sponsored.sum: Places limits on the additional member contributions required of certain EMTs in the twenty-five year retirement program.

sponsored.t: Grants service credit to members of the uniformed correction force of the New York city department of correction covered by provisions of law for over 25 years
sponsored.sum: Grants service credit to members of the uniformed correction force of the New York city department of correction covered by provisions of law for over 25 years.

sponsored.t: Relates to primary social security retirement benefits for members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Relates to primary social security retirement benefits for certain members; provides that in the computation of the normal service retirement benefit of members of the New York city fire department pension fund, there shall be no reduction for the primary social security retirement benefit.

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed as fire alarm dispatchers
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed as a fire alarm dispatcher, a supervising fire alarm dispatcher level one or a supervising fire alarm dispatcher level two of a fire department in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Provides for benefits for certain emergency medical technicians in the city of New York who suffer any condition or impairment of health caused by a stroke resulting in disability or death
sponsored.sum: Provides for benefits for certain emergency medical technicians or advanced emergency medical technicians in the city of New York who suffer any condition or impairment of health caused by a stroke resulting in disability or death.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for members of the NYC police pension fund
sponsored.sum: Provides that service retirement benefits for members of the NYC police pension fund shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Provides for a twenty year retirement of county correction officers in Suffolk county
sponsored.sum: Provides for a twenty year retirement of county correction officers in Suffolk county.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Provides that for New York city police/fire members, uniformed correction/sanitation revised plan and investigator revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors.

sponsored.t: Provides a lung disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors
sponsored.sum: Provides a lung disease presumption for correction officers, correction supervisors, deputy sheriff patrol or deputy sheriff patrol supervisors.

sponsored.t: Increases the amount of years of military service credit a member may purchase
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount of years of military service credit a member may purchase from three years to four years; provides that the provisions of such act shall not be subject to the requirement that the state shall make an equal payment to the retirement system.

sponsored.t: Relates to longevity bonuses for members of the uniformed service with the New York city fire department
sponsored.sum: Provides for salary bonuses for members of the uniformed service with the New York city fire department who retire with at least twenty-five, thirty or thirty-five years of service.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system for P'nina Gluck
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Tier IV status in the New York state and local employees' retirement system for P'nina Gluck.

sponsored.t: Relates to death benefits for members of the uniformed force of the New York city department of sanitation and members of the uniformed force of the New York city department of correction
sponsored.sum: Relates to death benefits for members of the uniformed force of the New York city department of sanitation and members of the uniformed force of the New York city department of correction; establishes that the beneficiaries of a member who would have been entitled to a service retirement benefit at the time of such member's death may elect to receive, in a lump sum, an amount payable which shall be equal to the pension reserve that would have been established had the member retired on the date of such member's death, or the value of the death benefit and the reserve-for-increased-take-home-pay, if any, whichever is greater.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing benefits payable by the correction officers' variable supplements fund to beneficiaries
sponsored.sum: Increases benefits payable by the correction officers' variable supplements fund to beneficiaries.

sponsored.t: Provides that New York city correction officers may file for disability without ten years of service
sponsored.sum: Provides that New York city correction officers may file for disability without ten years of service.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retirement of county and municipal airport firefighters
sponsored.sum: Provides for an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for certain airport firefighters employed by a county or municipality.

sponsored.t: Relates to the treatment of prior service with certain agencies by the New York city police pension fund
sponsored.sum: Includes prior service with certain agencies in creditable service for the purposes of the New York city police pension fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to first grade firefighters and promotions from the firefighter rank
sponsored.sum: Provides for longevity bonuses relating to first grade firefighters and promotions from the firefighter rank.

sponsored.t: Relates to employee representation of state employees designated managerial or confidential
sponsored.sum: Provides notification of employment or promotion of applicable employees to organizations of state employees designated managerial or confidential for purposes of employee representation in determining the terms and conditions of employment.

sponsored.t: Establishes a mandatory statewide, classroom-based water safety education program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a mandatory statewide, classroom-based water safety education program; provides that the commissioner of education shall work with New York State Association for Health, Physical Education, Recreation and Dance certified educators to develop and promulgate a statewide, age-appropriate, classroom-based water safety education guidance document; provides that within twenty-four months of the effective date of the bill, the department of education shall initiate statewide implementation of water safety education; provides that instruction shall be classroom-based and waterless and shall not require student access to aquatic facilities, swimming instruction, or in-water assessment.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending the benefits of the variable supplements fund for transit police members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Extends the benefits of the variable supplements fund for transit police members of the New York city employees' retirement system for persons who retired on or after October 1, 1968.

sponsored.t: Provides WTC-related benefits to certain employees who worked at the Verrazano Bridge Toll Facility
sponsored.sum: Provides WTC-related benefits to certain employees who worked at the Verrazano Bridge Toll Facility.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law which requires appointing authorities to provide appointment and promotion letters
sponsored.sum: Relates to the effectiveness of provisions of law which requires appointing authorities to provide appointment and promotion letters when extending an offer of appointment or promotion to a position in the classified service.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the county of Dutchess to offer an optional twenty-five year retirement plan to certain deputy sheriffs employed by such county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the county of Dutchess to offer an optional twenty-five year retirement plan to certain deputy sheriffs employed by such county.

sponsored.t: Provides a disability presumption to members of public retirement systems
sponsored.sum: Provides that a member of a public retirement system who has been determined to have a permanent partial disability by the workers' compensation board of the state of New York, and who the United States social security administration has determined is disabled for substantial gainful activity, and approved for social security disability benefits, shall be deemed to be disabled for the purposes of eligibility for disability benefits of such public retirement system.

sponsored.t: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers and sanitation workers
sponsored.sum: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers and sanitation workers.

sponsored.t: Relate to service retirement of members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Removes the twenty-five year requirement for tier three escalation for service retirement of members of the New York city fire department pension fund.

sponsored.t: Provides a legacy credit to the children and siblings of veterans who were killed in the line of duty
sponsored.sum: Provides a legacy credit to the children and siblings of veterans who were killed in the line of duty including veterans who were disabled as a result of their service, exposed to toxic substances, or presumptive conditions determined by the department of veterans affairs.

sponsored.t: Relates to accidental disability retirement for sheriffs
sponsored.sum: Relates to accidental disability retirement for sheriffs; provides that sheriffs shall receive a pension of three-quarters of their final average salary.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability benefits for certain deputy sheriff members in the sheriff's department of N.Y. City
sponsored.sum: Provides a presumption for accidental disability benefits for certain deputy sheriff members in the sheriff's department of a city with a population of one million or more who in performance of their duties contract human immunodeficiency virus (HIV), tuberculosis or hepatitis.

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed by the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed by the Triborough bridge and tunnel authority as a bridge and tunnel officer, sergeant or lieutenant in a non-managerial position.

sponsored.t: Relates to veterans' preferences with respect to civil service promotions
sponsored.sum: Relates to veterans' preferences with respect to civil service promotions; removes requirement of service during a time of war for additional points on civil service examinations for veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to the limitation of overtime compensation in final average salary calculations
sponsored.sum: Increases the limitation of overtime compensation in final average salary calculations from fifteen percent to thirty percent.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a thirty year retirement benefit for certain members in Nassau county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a thirty year retirement benefit for certain members in Nassau county; provides a retirement allowance equal to 60 percent of a member's final average salary.

sponsored.t: Limits the number of consecutive hours worked by certain employees of N.Y. city
sponsored.sum: Limits the number of consecutive hours worked by certain employees of cities of one million or more; provides that employees of cities of one million or more who are subject to a collective bargaining agreement shall not work more than 17 consecutive hours in a work day.

sponsored.t: Relates to protecting retiree health insurance benefits
sponsored.sum: Relates to protecting retiree health insurance benefits; provides that the health insurance benefits provided to retired officers, employees, and their dependents by the state and its political subdivisions shall not be diminished or impaired below the actuarial value of the benefits provided as of December thirty-first, two thousand twenty-one.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retirement of correction officers of the Westchester county correction department
sponsored.sum: Establishes a thirty-year retirement benefit for correction officers of the Westchester county correction department.

sponsored.t: Sets the increase to the overtime ceiling as a fixed percentage
sponsored.sum: Sets the increase to the overtime ceiling as a fixed percentage.

sponsored.t: Relates to retirement benefits for certain employees
sponsored.sum: Relates to the election of retirement benefits for certain members of the New York state and local employees' retirement system who are employed by the office of mental health.

sponsored.t: Requires subsidiaries of certain transportation authorities and their employees to submit all unresolvable contract negotiations to binding arbitration
sponsored.sum: Requires subsidiaries of certain authorities and their employees to submit all unresolvable contract negotiations to binding arbitration.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "gamblers unfairly abused by reward dynamics (GUARD) act"
sponsored.ls: Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law
sponsored.sum: Prohibits mobile sports wagering operators from providing certain incentives to individuals for certain actions that tend to increase gambling activities.

sponsored.t: Relates to a real property tax exemption for veterans with a one hundred percent service connected disability
sponsored.sum: Establishes an additional real property tax exemption for the primary residence of veterans with a one hundred percent service connected disability.

sponsored.t: Requires victims be notified of right to make a victim impact statement and allows them to personally appear at parole hearings and make such a statement
sponsored.sum: Requires the district attorney to notify victims by letter of the final disposition of the case within sixty days of such disposition in cases where such final disposition includes a conviction; provides such letter shall also notify victims of their right to make a victim impact statement; allows them to personally appear at parole hearings and make such a statement.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the imposition and collection of a fare, toll, rental, rate, charge or other fee on the Cross Bay Veterans Memorial Bridge
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the imposition and collection of a fare, toll, rental, rate, charge or other fee on the Cross Bay Veterans Memorial Bridge.

sponsored.t: Establishes a program for the sharing of veteran contact information
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program for the sharing of veteran contact information.

sponsored.t: Requires school crossing guards at high schools
sponsored.sum: Requires school crossing guards to be on each and every corner of every city block that contains a public or private high school during arrival and dismissal.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing a personal income tax deduction for tolls, fees and other related commuting expenses paid by a taxpayer in the course of commuting to and from their place of employment
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing a personal income tax deduction for tolls, fees and other related commuting expenses paid by a taxpayer in the course of commuting to and from their place of employment.

sponsored.t: Establishes St. Patrick's day as a school holiday for a city school district having a population of one million or more
sponsored.sum: Establishes St. Patrick's day, March 17th, as a school holiday for all city school districts of cities of one million inhabitants or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to instruction in financial management
sponsored.sum: Requires instruction in financial management for all students in grades four through eight.

sponsored.t: Offers installment payment plans as an option for persons with violations of toll collection regulations
sponsored.sum: Offers installment payment plans as an option for persons with violations of toll collection regulations before having their registration suspended.

sponsored.t: Relates to article 78 judgments regarding disability pension determinations
sponsored.sum: Permits court ruling in favor of a petitioner appealing the denial of a disability pension determination to grant disability pension.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing transportation for children with a disability
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing transportation for children with a disability; removes the requirement that a child attends the school the district is providing transportation to for the purpose of receiving services or programs similar to special educational programs recommended for such child by the local committee on special education.

sponsored.t: Exempts correction officers of any penal correctional institution from training requirements for security guards
sponsored.sum: Exempts correction officers of any penal correctional institution from training requirements for security guards.

sponsored.t: Provides that a fentanyl analogue shall be deemed to be a schedule I opiate
sponsored.sum: Provides that a fentanyl analogue shall be deemed to be a schedule I opiate.

sponsored.t: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree and the victim is a police officer
sponsored.sum: Makes life imprisonment without parole mandatory for defendants convicted of murder in the first degree and the victim is a police officer.

sponsored.t: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for certain police officers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for police officers employed in a police force of a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Includes certain activity in transit and transportation facilities with the crime of criminal trespass in the second degree
sponsored.sum: Includes certain activity in transit and transportation facilities within the crime of criminal trespass in the second degree.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring all banking organizations to have a notary public available during business hours
sponsored.sum: Requires all banking organizations to have a notary public available during business hours; permits banking organizations to charge a fee for such service.

sponsored.t: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for veterans
sponsored.sum: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for veterans who are residents of New York state.

sponsored.t: Prohibits cannabis retail and on-site consumption licensees from operating such premises within one thousand feet of the perimeter of a school grounds
sponsored.sum: Prohibits cannabis retail and on-site consumption licensees from operating such premises within one thousand feet of the perimeter of a school grounds; prohibits the advertising and marketing of cannabis content within one thousand feet of the perimeter of a school grounds, playgrounds, child day care providers, public parks, and libraries.

sponsored.t: Provides an exemption of any award from the September eleventh victim compensation fund from application to the satisfaction of money judgments
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption of any award from the September eleventh victim compensation fund from application to the satisfaction of money judgements.

sponsored.t: Designates September 11th as a public holiday
sponsored.sum: Designates September 11th as a public holiday to be known as September 11th Memorial and Remembrance Day.

sponsored.t: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for first responders
sponsored.sum: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for first responders employed by the state, any municipality, a recognized corporation or authority, or certified organization, thereof who are performing any part of their duties in the central business district.

sponsored.t: Provides protection to certain retirees from pension de-risking transactions
sponsored.sum: Provides protection to certain retirees from de-risking pension transactions.

sponsored.t: Relates to traffic ticket liability for midwives
sponsored.sum: Relates to traffic ticket liability for midwives responding to emergency medical situations.

sponsored.t: Designates certain emergency and public safety dispatchers and operators as first responders
sponsored.sum: Designates certain emergency and public safety dispatchers and operators as first responders.

sponsored.t: Relates to the prosecution of certain juveniles between the ages of 16 and 18 charged with certain felony offenses, including possession of a firearm
sponsored.sum: Relates to the prosecution of certain juveniles between the ages of 16 and 18 charged with certain felony offenses, including possession of a firearm; relates to the transfer of such cases to family court.

sponsored.t: Categorizes the assault of certain employees of the New York city department of buildings or the New York city department of housing preservation and development as a class D felony
sponsored.sum: Categorizes the assault of certain employees of the New York city department of buildings or the New York city department of housing preservation and development as a class D felony.

sponsored.t: Provides for longevity payments for certain state employees
sponsored.sum: Provides for annual longevity payments for certain state employees designated managerial or confidential.

sponsored.sum: Provides for comparable salary and other benefits for state employees designated managerial or confidential to ensure such employees receive an increase in salary at least equal to the percentage of the general salary increases provided to employees in a bargaining unit that receives the highest percentage general salary increase and other benefits.

sponsored.t: Provides for salary schedule parity
sponsored.sum: Provides for salary schedule parity for positions designated managerial or confidential with comparable union-represented positions.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing and directing the metropolitan transportation authority to implement a free fare program for NYC firefighters on the LIRR
sponsored.sum: Authorizes and directs the metropolitan transportation authority to implement a free fare program on the Long Island Rail Road for firefighters employed by the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to recovery of alleged overpayment of wages
sponsored.sum: Establishes a minimum threshold of five hundred dollars for recovery of overpayment of wages; provides an employee who is alleged to have been overpaid notice and an opportunity to respond to such allegation prior to the state seeking such recovery.

sponsored.t: Relates to the suspension of tolls collected during a state declaration of disaster emergency
sponsored.sum: Requires the suspension of the collection of tolls on public roads during a state declaration of disaster emergency on the New York state thruway.

sponsored.t: Designates sheriffs, under-sheriffs and deputy sheriffs of the city of New York as police officers
sponsored.sum: Designates sheriffs, under-sheriffs and deputy sheriffs of the city of New York as police officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a tax credit for small businesses which are required to have and maintain marine bulkheads
sponsored.sum: Creates a tax credit for small businesses which are required to have and maintain marine bulkheads for the full cost of such maintenance during the taxable year.

sponsored.t: Relates to hearing procedures for certain public employees
sponsored.sum: Relates to hearing procedures for certain public employees; provides that the recommendation of a hearing officer in relation to designated managerial and confidential employees shall be considered final and not subject to change or modification.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a variable supplements fund for sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a variable supplements fund for sanitation members of the New York city employees' retirement system; creates a board to manage such fund and to make payments.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Ildefonso Romero's law" to establish the felony offense of aggravated assault
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Ildefonso Romero's law" to establish the felony offense of aggravated assault for the causation of serious physical injury to or death of, as the case may be, any person, with intent to cause physical injury to such person or a third person.

sponsored.t: Relates to the compensation of certain emergency medical technicians who are providing emergency medical services, and their supervisors, during outbreaks of infectious diseases
sponsored.sum: Provides for a hazardous pay differential for certain emergency medical technicians who are providing emergency medical services, and their supervisors, during outbreaks of infectious diseases.

sponsored.t: Grants court reporters peace officer status
sponsored.sum: Grants court reporters and senior court reporters of the unified court system peace officer status.

sponsored.t: Relates to safety recalls on used motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Relates to safety recalls on used motor vehicles; requires dealers to provide notice to purchasers of safety recalls.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a central business district toll exemption for certain employees of the fire department of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for employees of the fire department of the city of New York in the title of firefighter, fire marshal, marine engineer, pilot or wiper.

sponsored.t: Relates to extending provisions of law relating to the New York state adult cystic fibrosis program
sponsored.sum: Relates to extending provisions of law relating to the New York state adult cystic fibrosis program until 2030.

sponsored.t: Restores 20 year service retirement for New York city police officers
sponsored.sum: Restores 20 year service retirement for New York city police officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crime of aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual
sponsored.sum: Relates to the crime of aggravated harassment of an employee by an incarcerated individual; requires any imprisonment imposed by such conviction run consecutively to any undischarged term of imprisonment to which the defendant is subject.

sponsored.t: Relates to waiving the earning limitations for retired sworn officers employed by a district attorney as investigators
sponsored.sum: Relates to waiving the earning limitations for retired sworn officers employed by a district attorney as investigators.

sponsored.t: Establishes the disability benefits maximization and assistance program to assist eligible state retirees in obtaining certain disability benefits
sponsored.sum: Establishes the disability benefits maximization and assistance program to assist eligible state retirees in obtaining certain disability benefits; provides for the investing of any net savings realized by the program back into the New York state health insurance program for the purpose of eliminating or limiting the impact of any premium rate or other cost increases that would be the responsibility of an employee or retiree.

sponsored.t: Relates to promotions of police detectives, sergeants, and lieutenants for retirement purposes
sponsored.sum: Relates to promotions of police detectives, sergeants, and lieutenants for retirement purposes.

sponsored.t: Extends the pilot program to examine the effects of waiving the state civil service examination fee
sponsored.sum: Extends the pilot program to examine the effects of waiving the state civil service examination fee to December 31, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to requests for employee personnel records
sponsored.sum: Requires agencies and public employers to provide notice and a review period to employees whose personnel records have been provided pursuant to the state's freedom of information law.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a twenty-five year retirement plan for firefighters employed by the division of military and naval affairs
sponsored.sum: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement plan for firefighters employed by the division of military and naval affairs.

sponsored.t: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system
sponsored.sum: Relates to service retirement benefits for certain members of the New York city employees' retirement system; provides that for New York city uniformed correction/sanitation revised plan members of the New York city employees' retirement system, the service retirement benefit shall not be reduced by the primary social security retirement benefit commencing at age sixty-two.

sponsored.t: Authorizes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for uniformed court officers and peace officers employed by the unified court system
sponsored.sum: Authorizes an optional twenty-five year retirement plan for uniformed court officers and peace officers employed by the unified court system.

sponsored.t: Relates to hearing officers
sponsored.sum: Expands the authority of hearing officers regarding judgments about an employee's inability to perform their duties due to a disability to be provided to the employee and the authorized representative of such employee.

sponsored.t: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for certain emergency medical technicians and fire protection inspectors
sponsored.sum: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for certain emergency medical technicians and fire protection inspectors.

sponsored.t: Includes persons holding positions by appointment or employment in the organized militia of the state as public employees
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of public employee to include persons holding positions by appointment or employment in the organized militia of the state.

sponsored.t: Removes eligibility or receipt of primary social security disability benefits as a condition for ordinary disability retirement for certain members
sponsored.sum: Removes eligibility or receipt of primary social security disability benefits as a condition for ordinary disability retirement for New York city enhanced plan members in active service who are not eligible for a normal retirement benefit and have completed five years or more of service.

sponsored.t: Provides for cost-of-living adjustments
sponsored.sum: Provides for cost-of-living adjustments; provides that the base benefit amount shall be increased annually by reference to the consumer price index for each applicable calendar year beginning on September 1, 2025.

sponsored.t: Waives the central business district toll for New York city sheriffs, undersheriffs or deputy sheriffs acting in their official capacity
sponsored.sum: Waives the central business district toll for New York city sheriffs, undersheriffs or deputy sheriffs acting in their official capacity.

sponsored.t: Designates certain traffic enforcement agents as peace officers
sponsored.sum: Designates all agents employed by the city of New York police department in the titles of traffic enforcement agent I and traffic enforcement agent II as peace officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to driving while ability impaired by fatigue and aggravated driving while ability impaired by fatigue
sponsored.sum: Relates to driving while ability impaired by fatigue and aggravated driving while ability impaired by fatigue; makes aggravated driving while ability impaired by fatigue a misdemeanor.

sponsored.t: Establishes alternative twenty and twenty-five year plans for certain officers of state law enforcement
sponsored.sum: Establishes alternative twenty and twenty-five year plans for every non-seasonally appointed sworn member or officer of the division of law enforcement in the department of environmental conservation, a forest ranger in the service of the department of environmental conservation, which shall mean a person who serves on a full-time basis in the title of forest ranger I, forest ranger II, forest ranger III, assistant superintendent of forest fire control, or any successor titles or new titles in the forest ranger title series in the department of environmental conservation, a police officer in the department of environmental conservation, the regional state park police, and university of…

sponsored.t: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers
sponsored.sum: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to procedures to be followed in appointing a hearing officer for removal and disciplinary action against certain public employees
sponsored.sum: Provides procedures to be followed in appointing a hearing officer for removal and disciplinary action against certain public employees not in the service of the city of New York, including the fees to be paid for such hearing officer; provides for suspension, with pay, pending the determination.

sponsored.t: Provides for service credit related to the birth or adoption of a new child
sponsored.sum: Provides for service credit related to the birth or adoption of a new child for certain correction officer retirement system members.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing geographic pay differentials for certain police officers
sponsored.sum: Relates to authorizing geographic pay differentials for certain police officers; authorizes a pay differential for regional state park police, forest ranger, environmental conservation officer, and university police officer titles when wage rates of police officers in a given location are substantially higher than the wage rates paid by the state.

sponsored.t: Relates to death benefits for members of the uniformed force of the fire department of the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Provides for beneficiaries of the death benefits of an eligible uniformed member of the fire department of the city of New York the ability to elect to receive such benefits in a certain lump-sum amount.

sponsored.t: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city sanitation workers
sponsored.sum: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city sanitation workers.

sponsored.t: Establishes maximum age requirements for New York city correctional officers
sponsored.sum: Establishes maximum age requirements for New York city correction officers; provides that the commissioner of correction shall not appoint a person as a correction officer if such person is more than thirty-five years of age as of the date of the applicant's appointment or eligibility to compete in a promotion examination.

sponsored.t: Permits political subdivisions and municipal corporations of the state to set the residency requirements for certain positions
sponsored.sum: Permits political subdivisions and municipal corporations of the state to set the residency requirements for public officer positions.

sponsored.t: Creates a distinctive parking placard to allow midwives to park closer to patients' homes in order to provide swift care
sponsored.sum: Creates a distinctive parking placard to allow midwives to park closer to patients' homes in order to provide quicker access and swift care.

sponsored.t: Removes post-retirement earnings restrictions for New York city department of corrections uniformed personnel
sponsored.sum: Removes post-retirement earnings restrictions for New York city department of correction uniformed personnel with respect to a retiree subsequent to such member's earliest eligibility date for service retirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the eligibility of New York city transit authority employees for performance of duty disability retirement
sponsored.sum: Relates to the eligibility of New York city transit authority employees for performance of duty disability retirement.

sponsored.t: Clarifies that the New York state health insurance program remains subject to certain provisions of the financial services law
sponsored.sum: Clarifies that the New York state health insurance program remains subject to certain provisions of the financial services law and coverage for usual and customary costs for out-of-network health care service.

sponsored.t: Relates to comparable salary and other benefits for state employees designated managerial or confidential
sponsored.sum: Provides for comparable salary and other benefits for state employees designated managerial or confidential which shall not be withheld unless an employee has received a formal written performance evaluation rating of unsatisfactory or its equivalent.

sponsored.t: Establishes a twenty-two year retirement program for deputy sheriff members
sponsored.sum: Establishes a twenty-two year retirement program for deputy sheriff members who are employed by the city of New York as a deputy city sheriff level one, deputy city sheriff level two, supervising deputy sheriff or administrative sheriff.

sponsored.t: Establishes a managerial or confidential higher education differential
sponsored.sum: Establishes a managerial or confidential higher education differential for employees designated managerial or confidential who hold an earned associate's degree, bachelor's degree, master's degree, or doctorate (e.g., MD, JD, Ph.D.) from a college or university or a professional license issued by the New York state education department are eligible to receive a higher education differential of up to six hundred dollars retroactively for state fiscal year two thousand twenty-four-two thousand twenty-five and for state fiscal year two thousand twenty-five-two thousand twenty-six.

sponsored.t: Directs the state civil service commission to amend the sick leave accrual rates for state employees designated managerial or confidential
sponsored.sum: Directs the state civil service commission to amend the sick leave accrual rates for state employees designated managerial or confidential to be credited with sick leave at the rate of 13 days per year.

sponsored.t: Requires appointing authorities to provide appointment and promotion letters
sponsored.sum: Requires appointing authorities to provide appointment and promotion letters when extending an offer of appointment or promotion to a position in the classified service.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 38 Chapter 657 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 6624, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the civil service law, in relation to requiring appointing authorities to provide appointment and promotion letters" APPROVED This bill would provide salary and benefit information to incoming and current public employees seeking employment and promotion into new posi- tions. I support providing clear salary and benefit information to public employees. sponsored.t: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers and sanitation workers
sponsored.sum: Restores the 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers and sanitation workers.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a thirty year retirement benefit for certain members in Nassau county
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a thirty year retirement benefit for certain members in Nassau county; provides a retirement allowance equal to 60 percent of a member's final average salary.

sponsored.t: Extends the September 11th worker protection task force act
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of the September 11th worker protection task force act.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rights of public employees related to suspension or demotion upon the abolition or reduction of positions
sponsored.sum: Provides that no provision of section eighty of the civil service law shall modify, replace or supersede any provision of a collective bargaining agreement that provides for greater rights than required by such section.

sponsored.t: Extends for four fiscal years the current 7% per annum statutory rate of interest used in valuing retirement system liabilities for the purpose of computing the amount of employer contributions
sponsored.sum: Relates to the rate of interest used in the actuarial valuation of liabilities for the purpose of calculating contributions to the New York city employees' retirement system, the New York city teachers' retirement system, the police pension fund, subchapter two, the fire department pension fund, subchapter two and the board of education retirement system of such city by public employers and other obligors required to make employer contributions to such retirement systems, the crediting of special interest and additional interest and additional interest to members of such retirement systems, and the allowance of supplementary interest on the funds of such retirement systems; extends such…

sponsored.t: Establishes a real property tax exemption for veterans with a 100 percent service connected disability
sponsored.sum: Establishes a real property tax exemption for the primary residence of veterans with a 100 percent service connected disability.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability benefits for certain individuals employed by the Nassau county police department
sponsored.sum: Provides a performance of duty presumption for diseases of the heart for members who serve as an ambulance medical technician, ambulance medical coordinator, ambulance medical technician/supervisor or a member who performs ambulance medical technician related services, or a police medic, police medic coordinator, police medic supervisor, bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, assistant bureau director police emergency ambulance services - county, or a member who performs police medic or police emergency ambulance related services and is employed in the Nassau county police department.

sponsored.t: Grants certain county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service beyond twenty-five years
sponsored.sum: Grants Nassau county fire marshals, supervising fire marshals, fire marshals, assistant fire marshals, assistant chief fire marshals or chief fire marshals pension benefits for service rendered beyond twenty-five years.

sponsored.t: Relates to disabilities of members of the uniformed force of sanitation departments in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Provides a performance and discharge of duty presumption for any condition of impairment of health caused by leptospirosis, resulting in total or partial disability or death to a paid member of the uniformed force of a paid sanitation department, where such paid member is drawn from competitive civil service lists, who successfully passed a physical examination on entry into the service of such department, which examination failed to reveal any evidence of such condition.

sponsored.t: Relates to World Trade Center benefits
sponsored.sum: Relates to filing timely notices of participation in World Trade Center rescue efforts for the purposes of receiving World Trade Center benefits.

sponsored.t: Provides for eligibility of certain participants in the New York City employees retirement system to opt into the twenty-five year retirement program for EMT members
sponsored.sum: Provides for eligibility of certain participants in the New York City employees retirement system to opt into the twenty-five year retirement program for EMT members.

sponsored.t: Relates to normal retirement age for police/fire members of the New York city fire department pension fund
sponsored.sum: Provides that the normal service retirement benefit for police/fire members who are members of the New York city fire department pension fund shall be paid to such members of the New York city fire department pension fund without regard to age upon retirement after twenty years of service.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for participants in the automotive 25 year/age 50 pension plan with more than 30 years of credited service who remain in active service after age 62 to receive a service retirement benefit
sponsored.sum: Relates to eligibility for participants in the automotive 25 year/age 50 pension plan with more than 30 years of credited service who remain in active service after age 62 to receive a service retirement benefit equivalent to the standard service retirement benefit received by Tier IV members with the same age and service.

sponsored.t: Provides for the transfer of service credit between certain retirement systems
sponsored.sum: Provides for the transfer of service credit by a member of the New York city police pension fund into the New York city police pension fund.

sponsored.t: Permits surviving spouses of certain retirement plan members to retain certain benefits upon remarriage
sponsored.sum: Permits surviving spouses of NYC police pension fund members to retain accidental death benefits upon remarriage.

sponsored.t: Provides a heart disease presumption for certain members employed as probation officers
sponsored.sum: Provides a heart disease presumption for members employed as a probation officer, supervising probation officer or probation officer trainee of a department of probation in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Provides for a line of duty presumption for disabilities of deputy sheriffs in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Provides for a disability retirement for certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Provides for a line of duty disability presumption for any condition of impairment of health caused by diseases of the lung, resulting in total or partial disability or death of certain deputy sheriff members of a retirement system in certain cities.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of overtime ceiling
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of overtime ceiling for members who first become members of a public retirement system of the state on or after April first, two thousand twelve.

sponsored.t: Permits certain twenty-five year retirement program dispatcher members to file elections not to participate
sponsored.sum: Permits certain twenty-five year retirement program dispatcher members to file elections not to participate.

sponsored.t: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police
sponsored.sum: Establishes a twenty-five year retirement program for members of the NYC employees' retirement system employed as water supply police; provides for employer pick-up of certain additional member contributions required to be made by certain participants in the 25-year retirement programs.

sponsored.t: Includes remedial services, homework or childcare as the transportation responsibility of the city school district located in New York City
sponsored.sum: Includes remedial services, homework or childcare as the transportation responsibility of the city school district located in a city having a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people
sponsored.sum: Sets minimum staffing standards for employees performing emergency medical services in the 911 system in a city with a population of over one million people.

sponsored.t: Relates to terms and conditions of employment for members of the collective negotiating unit consisting of investigators, senior investigators, and investigative specialists in the state police; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to terms and conditions of employment for members of the collective negotiating unit consisting of investigators, senior investigators, and investigative specialists in the division of state police; relates to the employee benefit fund for members of such unit; makes an appropriation therefor; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to death benefits for NYC transit authority members
sponsored.sum: Provides an option for beneficiaries of NYC transit authority members to receive a lump sum equal to the pension reserve where a member who is eligible for a service retirement dies prior to filing for retirement.

sponsored.t: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system
sponsored.sum: Relates to age and service eligibility requirements for ordinary retirement for members of the unified court system; restores 55/30 for all members; reduces the retirement age from 63 to 62.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the removal of police officer candidates from an eligible list when such candidate does not meet psychological fitness requirements or lacks good moral character standards
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the removal of police officer candidates from an eligible list when such candidate does not meet psychological fitness requirements or lacks good moral character standards.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing certain special accidental death benefits
sponsored.sum: Increases certain special accidental death benefits for state and local retirement system members.

sponsored.t: Relates to terms and condition of employment, salary schedules, and other terms any agreement for members of certain collective negotiating units consisting of persons in the division of state police; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to the terms and conditions of employment for members of the collective negotiating unit consisting of troopers in the division of state police and salary schedules for members of such unit; relates to the employee benefit fund for members of such unit; provides for the payment of overtime pursuant to the terms of any agreement (Part A); relates to the terms and conditions of employment for members of the collective negotiating unit consisting of commissioned and non-commissioned officers in the division of state police and salary schedules for members of such unit; relates to the employee benefit fund for members of such unit (Part B).

sponsored.t: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of environmental conservation to conduct a study of ecological restoration needs of Jamaica Bay; imposes a five-year moratorium on placing sediment or fill in the borrow pits in Jamaica Bay.

sponsored.t: Relates to employee representation of state employees designated managerial or confidential
sponsored.sum: Provides notification of employment or promotion of applicable employees to organizations of state employees designated managerial or confidential for purposes of employee representation in determining the terms and conditions of employment.
